members.name: PawSharp.Client.DiscordClientIntentValidationExtensions
members.summary: Extension methods for  to support event interest validation.
members.remarks:
These extensions provide ergonomic APIs for validating that handlers' required intents
            are enabled before connecting to the gateway, catching configuration bugs early.

members.name: PawSharp.Client.DiscordClientIntentValidationExtensions.ValidateIntents(PawSharp.Client.DiscordClient,PawSharp.Core.Enums.GatewayIntents)
members.summary:
Validates that all registered gateway event handlers have their required intents enabled.
            Logs warnings for any mismatches and collects detailed validation results.
members.returns: A summary of intent validation issues (empty if all valid)

params.name: enabledIntents
params.description: The intents that are currently enabled

members.name: PawSharp.Client.DiscordClientIntentValidationExtensions.GetRecommendedIntents(PawSharp.Client.DiscordClient)
members.summary:
Gets the recommended set of intents based on all currently registered handlers.
            Useful for suggesting minimal working intent configuration.
members.remarks:
Returns only the intents needed for registered handlers, excluding extra intents.
            This is useful when you want to determine the minimal permission set your bot needs.
members.returns: Recommended intents, or (GatewayIntents)0 if no handlers are registered

members.name: PawSharp.Client.DiscordClientIntentValidationExtensions.LogIntentSummary(PawSharp.Client.DiscordClient,PawSharp.Core.Enums.GatewayIntents)
members.summary:
Logs a summary of which intents are currently enabled and which are recommended.
            Useful for debugging intent configuration at startup.

params.name: enabledIntents
params.description: The intents that are currently enabled

members.name: PawSharp.Client.IntentValidationResult
members.summary: Result of an intent validation check, containing summary of any mismatches.

members.name: PawSharp.Client.IntentValidationResult.EnabledIntents
members.summary: The intents that were enabled during validation.

members.name: PawSharp.Client.IntentValidationResult.Count
members.summary: Number of issues found (events with missing intents).

members.name: PawSharp.Client.IntentValidationResult.IsValid
members.summary: True if validation passed (no issues found).

members.name: PawSharp.Client.IntentValidationResult.Issues
